headline: How a Physiotherapy Clinic Built a Steadier, Lower-Cost Google Ads Lead Pipeline
executive_summary: True Life Wellness Physio is a physiotherapy clinic that had advertised on Google Ads for several years. The account drew steady traffic, but conversion tracking under the earlier structure captured only a couple of measurable enquiries a month. PPC Guru rebuilt the account around higher-intent physiotherapy searches and put reliable call and booking tracking in place. Under management, the account has produced a consistent flow of roughly 16 tracked booking enquiries a month at about $34 each — on a similar, slightly lower budget. This case study compares the clinic's earlier period (2021) with the first 12 months under PPC Guru (Apr 2023 – Mar 2024), based on the account's Google Ads history in CAD.
opportunity: True Life Wellness Physio already had an established Google Ads presence, so the clinic was reaching searchers and earning clicks each month. The available account history shows steady impressions and traffic, but only a small number of tracked conversions — which pointed to a clear opportunity in measurement and structure. With reliable call and booking-form tracking, the clinic could see which searches actually produced enquiries; with a tighter, higher-intent keyword structure, more of that existing traffic could be turned into booked appointments. The demand was already there. The opportunity was to build a conversion-focused paid search account around it and give the practice dependable visibility into the leads its budget was generating.
strategy_intro: PPC Guru rebuilt the account with a lead-generation-first structure and re-established clean conversion measurement.
strategy_bullets: Restructured the account into focused search campaigns targeting high-intent physiotherapy and injury-treatment queries.
Strengthened conversion tracking so booking-form submissions and phone calls were measured consistently.
Rebuilt keyword coverage with tighter match types and an ongoing negative-keyword programme to filter low-intent traffic.
Aligned ad copy and extensions with the clinic's core services and local service area.
Concentrated budget on the campaigns and search terms that produced booked appointments.
Applied ongoing search-term review and bid adjustments to keep cost per booking stable as volume grew.
key_results: Established a consistent flow of roughly 16 tracked booking enquiries per month under PPC Guru management.
Cost per tracked conversion settled at about $34 across the first year of management.
Conversion tracking was strengthened, giving the clinic reliable measurement of calls and booking requests.
The steadier results were delivered on a similar, slightly lower monthly budget (≈$610 → ≈$545).
The account moved from an average of about two tracked conversions a month to dependable double-digit monthly lead volume.

early_stage.intro: The new structure produced enquiries from the first month, then settled into a steady monthly rhythm as targeting and tracking were refined.

business_impact: For a physiotherapy clinic, the value of paid search is measured in booked appointments, not just clicks. By focusing spend on higher-intent searches and measuring bookings and calls accurately, PPC Guru turned a largely traffic-driven account into a dependable source of appointment requests. Just as important, the clinic can now see the leads its budget produces each month — around 16 tracked enquiries at a stable, low cost per booking. That predictability gives the practice a reliable local lead pipeline and a clear basis for deciding when and how to scale.
why_it_worked: Higher-intent keyword and match-type targeting focused spend on searchers ready to book.
Stronger conversion tracking made booking requests and calls measurable and optimisable.
Continuous search-term and negative-keyword refinement kept traffic relevant over time.
Budget was concentrated on the campaigns and queries that produced appointments.
A clean, conversion-first account structure created a stable foundation for ongoing optimization.
conclusion: True Life Wellness Physio shows the value of pairing a conversion-focused rebuild with reliable measurement. On a similar budget, the clinic moved from a couple of tracked enquiries a month to a steady flow of around 16, at a stable cost of roughly $34 each. The result is a more predictable local lead pipeline and clearer visibility into performance — the foundation PPC Guru continues to optimize for the account.
cta: Looking to turn physiotherapy search traffic into booked appointments? PPC Guru helps Canadian clinics build conversion-focused Google Ads campaigns backed by transparent reporting and ongoing optimization.
